text:
Maya: Standup - kernel/batching/KV
- yesterday: landed microbatch slotting fix that reduced tail latency on long seq by ~12% (bench: p95 420ms -> 370ms). Ran canary on dev cluster.
- blockers: seeing KV eviction spike when batch size > 8 for seq > 2048, can reproduce with dev config but need a labelled trace from canary. PR #482 still needs review.
- today: dig into eviction heuristic, push small KV metric change to canary, review PR.

Alex: Nice. Can you paste the bench command you used? I want to reproduce.

Maya: Sure:
```
./bench --model=gptx --seq=4096 --concurrency=16 --batching=on --kv-cache=hot
```
Also uploaded the canary logs: <https://ci.internal/bench/6135801234> (perf stdout + kernel logs).

Pranav: I'll take PR #482 review. On the eviction spike, could it be the hot-set detection threshold? I saw a similar pattern when we changed slotting.

Sam: Quick note - I'm about to roll kernel 2.3.1 to staging; will pause if this KV thing is blocking. ETA ~10m for the rollout.

Maya: Please hold on the rollout. If the staging kernel touches KV config it could amplify evictions. I'll attempt a targeted canary with telemetry in ~20m and post results here.

BenchBot: Canary run completed (id: canary-6135801234) — tail p95: 372ms, OOMs: 0, evictions/sec: 0.8 -> 3.2 (after microbatch size bump).

Alex: Reproduced locally with Maya's command, see evict rate jump when microbatch size >= 9. I'll try bisecting the microbatch threshold and report numbers.

Pranav: Heads-up, I just merged a telemetry tweak that adds kv.evict.cause and kv.evict.hotset.label. That should make traces easier to filter.

Maya: Perfect — once telemetry lands I'll re-run the canary with the new labels and share the trace link. Anyone able to jump on a quick sync in 15? If not, async updates here are fine.

Sam: Free in 15.

Alex: async ok for me too.

Maya: Ok will post results. TL;DR for now: please don't roll kernel -> staging until I confirm this isn't a regression from the slotting change. :thumbsup:

Pranav: Noted. Ping me if you need help collecting the KV trace or adding extra labels.

Maya: Thanks all.
